title: Add mandatory implementation_done gate
description:
Implement a hard gate that requires the agent to call implementation_done before the attempt can complete. If the agent exceeds a reasonable iteration limit (e.g., 50 tool calls) without calling it, the gate should fail the attempt and provide feedback about the missing completion signal. This prevents agents from getting stuck in analysis loops.
